metadata.title: Swarm Rebuild — Watch a Swarm Rebuild Any Web Page
metadata.description: Wipe any web page to a blank canvas and watch a swarm of multiplayer cursors rebuild it live with boxes, text, guides and duplicates.
metadata.keywords: swarm rebuild, chrome extension, cursor animation, page rebuild, design tool animation, multiplayer cursors
